item.text: {"summary":"A deciduous flowering shrub native and endemic to Japan, mophead hydrangea bears large pink or blue flower heads in summer and autumn. Wild plants have flat flower heads with small fertile flowers ringed by a few large sterile ones, while cultivated mopheads usually form rounded heads dominated by large sterile flowers.","humanEdibility":"yes","edibilityNote":"Amacha is a Japanese beverage made from fermented leaves of H. macrophylla var. thunbergii.","evidence":{"summary":["s1:p1","s1:p2","s1:p6"],"humanEdibility":["s1:p13"]}}
